rows.name: Fire and rescue incident statistics, year ending March 2026
rows.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
rows.semantic_limit: England and fire-and-rescue-service aggregates support national and FRS calibration only; they do not identify an exact parcel, building ignition point or household risk.
rows.evidence_basis: Accredited official statistics cover incidents, fires, casualties and response times for the year ending March 2026, including the transition from IRS to FaRDaP.

rows.name: Reported road casualties Great Britain, provisional results: 2025
rows.semantic_limit: National provisional casualty totals and trends cannot be represented as an exact road segment, junction or parcel-level safety measurement.
rows.evidence_basis: Accredited official statistics report provisional 2025 fatalities, KSI casualties and all-severity casualties on public roads in Great Britain.

rows.name: Work-related fatal injuries in Great Britain, 2025/26
rows.semantic_limit: RIDDOR fatality totals by industry, accident kind, age and region are aggregate safety context and do not establish conditions at a named workplace or parcel.
rows.evidence_basis: HSE reports 126 worker fatalities and 104 public fatalities in 2025/26, with the worker figures provisional until July 2027.

rows.name: RIDFATAL and RIDDOR injury table index
rows.semantic_limit: Regional, industry and accident-kind tables permit bounded calibration only; local-authority or regional values must not be converted into exact workplace or parcel observations.
rows.evidence_basis: The official HSE table index identifies RIDFATAL as updated July 2026 and lists RIDDOR industry, region, age, accident-kind and site tables.

rows.name: In-year work-related deaths where HSE is the enforcing authority
rows.semantic_limit: Quarterly notifications are provisional, enforcement-scope limited and subject to later classification; they cannot be treated as final local or parcel-level evidence.
rows.evidence_basis: HSE states that the quarterly series covers reportable work-related fatal injuries where HSE is the main enforcing authority.

rows.name: Police workforce, England and Wales: 31 March 2026
rows.semantic_limit: Police-force-area workforce and frontline-role figures describe organisational capacity, not crime incidence, response quality at an address or exact parcel safety.
rows.evidence_basis: Accredited official statistics cover workforce counts, functions, joiners, leavers and police-force-area data as at 31 March 2026.

rows.name: Environment Agency real-time flood-monitoring API
rows.semantic_limit: Warnings, alerts, flood areas and station measurements are dynamic area or station data; an exact parcel risk statement requires spatial containment, timestamp and warning-state verification.
rows.evidence_basis: The official open API provides flood warnings, alerts, flood areas, river levels, flows and monitoring-station metadata without registration.

rows.name: Environment Agency rainfall API
rows.semantic_limit: Rainfall observations are station measurements and cannot be assigned to a parcel as exact on-site rainfall without verified station distance, period and interpolation controls.
rows.evidence_basis: The official rainfall API documents station observations within the Environment Agency real-time flood-monitoring service.
